$comment: ResoPal pull weights. Bushiroad has NOT published official Dawn of Palpagos pull rates; the hitSlot table below mirrors community box math (palstars / tcgtalk day-one openings of 60 packs) and is tuned for fun, not accuracy. Edit this file to change what players pull.

perPackBonus.$comment: Multipliers applied to this set's hit slot only. 1 = published odds. Raise for events.

globalBonus.$comment: Multiplier applied to every above-R rarity in every set. 1 = untouched; 2 = twice as generous.

celebrate.$comment: Rarities that trigger the on-screen celebration. big = full confetti burst.
